# F-001 · Payment timeouts are reported to the customer and to monitoring as card declines

| Status | Date | Source | Evidence level |
|---|---|---|---|
| confirmed | 2027-05-03 | query, code path | tenant |

**Severity:** P1, because a customer whose payment timed out is told the card was declined while money may be held. · **Decision:** proposed · **Implementation:** absent · **Verification:** reproduced.

**What we see.** 4 % of declines in the window were provider timeouts, 9 % on the Monday
(E-301); the spans carry no attempt id (E-302). Gap G-01.

**Confidence and limits.** High for the window read; one provider; earlier weeks not read.

**Why it matters.** Customers are told the wrong thing, and the dashboard stays green.

**What follows.** Ask the provider for the status after a timeout; alert on unknown attempts.
Owner: checkout tech lead. **Model:** observability

**Closing criterion.** A timed-out attempt is reported as unknown, and the alert fires on stage.

**Links.** F-002; D-08.
